quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya Plastics IR presentation: 1H26 Operations & Performance (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: widening supply shortages across ABF, CCL, copper foil and glass fabric; capacity crowding-out has triggered widespread shortages across glass yarn/fabric, copper foil, CCL and ABF substrates, with price hikes extending from high-end to standard and mid-range tiers; CCL utilization rates exceeding 90%; solid progress in high-end AI material qualifications; the company balances internal consumption with external sales across all product tiers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya Plastics IR presentation: 1H26 Operations & Performance (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 3Q26 outlook: growth remains centered on tech-oriented materials (Electronic Materials, polyester films, epoxy resins); in Electronic Materials, surging AI demand and consumer tech spec upgrades triggered broad-based raw material shortages across mid-to-high-end substrates, and high line utilization and elevated copper prices bolstered ASPs, driving solid growth in both volume and price; commodity chemicals and polyester face a softer market tone.
